architectureDecisions: D1 — BB-081 is acceptance/attribution/publication only; it cannot modify BB-077/078/079/080 semantics or product/effect authority to make a candidate pass.
D2 — Freeze compositional arms A=CORE_SYNC, B=A+BB-078, C=B+BB-079, D=C+BB-080. B/C are diagnostic; D is the sole promotion candidate.
D3 — Build arms from exact DONE exports. If B/C/D cannot be independently composed, stop with PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION rather than approximate the ablation.

D4 — Use exactly BB-077's four reserved Terminal-Bench 2.1 held-out digests, two repeats per arm/task, fresh trial/runtime/provider session per unit, and the balanced order schedule in ablationContract.

D5 — Reuse HARNESS_RUN_RECORD_V1 and BB-077 measurement/failure semantics, extended only with arm/dependency/repeat/fault fields plus reportContract-derived useful-operation and recovery views; unknown measurements remain null.
D6 — Primary decision is D vs A. Report A→B, B→C and C→D marginal vectors only for attribution; no B/C result can publish a supported profile.
D7 — Reuse BB-077's conjunctive gate unchanged: D quality >= A; safety negatives pass with zero duplicate effects; median D/A cost<=0.85, prompt input<=0.90, turns<=1.00, elapsed<=1.10.
D8 — Keep every registered task-repeat unit and retry in accounting. Report per-task 0/2|1/2|2/2 consistency; no best-of-k or significance claim from the bounded cohort.
D9 — Run safety/recovery faults as deterministic provider/tool/process fixtures with explicit arm applicability and N/A cells; do not mix fault fixtures into live-provider economics.

D10 — Any conclusive D safety violation (duplicate effect, lost terminal result, unsafe cancellation, stale-model dispatch, duplicate-wake storm or unresolved NON_RECONCILABLE ambiguity) forces KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE.
D11 — A deterministic reducer returns PROMOTE_ASYNC, KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE or INCONCLUSIVE from frozen evidence; Jev validates evidence claims but cannot rewrite the reducer outcome.
D12 — Publish CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1 only after PROMOTE_ASYNC; CORE_SYNC always remains supported, B/C remain diagnostic, and createAgentRuntime defaults are not silently changed.

D13 — Profile evidence binds protocol, dependency delivery hashes, provider/model profile, evaluated source and decision artifact; later mutation invalidates the evidence-backed claim. Rollback is quiescent-session only.
D14 — BB-074 remains downstream: it measures end-to-end delivery value after BB-081 profile support and cannot feed results backward into this frozen gate.

implementationSlices: S1 — Bind exact DONE BB-077/078/079/080 outputs, compute the dependency manifest, and fail PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION on missing/incompatible/non-composable seams.
S2 — Materialize A/B/C/D plus the four held-out digests, two-repeat balanced schedule, fixed BB-077 profile/budgets and protocol hashes.
S3 — Execute all 32 registered held-out arm units through the shared BB-077 Harbor adapter with fresh state/session identity and append-only HARNESS_RUN_RECORD_V1 accounting.

S4 — Emit reportContract metrics for every registered unit, D/A primary pairs and A→B/B→C/C→D attribution, including quality, input/output/cache tokens, cost, turns, tool calls, useful operations/turn, operation overlap, elapsed time, recovery outcome, repeat consistency and failure fingerprints.
S5 — Run the deterministic fault matrix and capture exact recovery/effect/fencing evidence without paid-provider dependence.
S6 — Run the frozen reducer for PROMOTE_ASYNC|KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE|INCONCLUSIVE; mutation tests cover missing/unknown/drift and every primary gate.
S7 — Publish the evidence-bound supported profile only after PROMOTE_ASYNC and update Core Living Docs with the actual decision, limitations and rollback boundary.

ablationContract.unit: task digest + repeatIndex + frozen profile hash
ablationContract.fixed: All BB-077 fixed factors, preflight/reset/leakage semantics and HARNESS_RUN_RECORD_V1
ablationContract.budget: BB-077 external limits: <=$0.60/unit, <=$25 live cohort, 16 turns, 64 host calls, 900s, 180k input, 12k output
ablationContract.comparison: D/A primary; A->B, B->C, C->D diagnostic; all units/attempts retained

scenarios: provider/termination separate from quality; no hidden usage/retry
failure fingerprint retained; verifier owns quality
exact operation/effect/generation on restart; zero duplicate effects
replay-policy truth; unresolved effect not relabelled cancelled
idempotent duplicate; binding conflict fails closed
at most one active wake; no turn storm

faultMatrix.rule: Undeclared arm/scenario cells are N/A, never passes. Every D-applicable assertion must pass and D duplicate external effects must be zero.

gates: D duplicate external effects=0 and all required D safety/recovery assertions pass
decisionContract.promote: complete 32-unit live cohort + complete required D fault evidence + all gates pass
decisionContract.keepSync: complete/known evidence and any primary gate conclusively fails
decisionContract.inconclusive: missing unit, budget stop, unknown primary accounting, verifier/task/profile/dependency drift, incomplete required fault evidence or invalid binding
decisionContract.authority: frozen deterministic reducer; Jev cannot override

profilePublicationContract.rollback: CORE_SYNC at new/quiescent session after async operations/effects are terminal or reconciled

toolActivationContract.source: exact delivered BB-077 held-out-relevant shell/fixture capability
toolActivationContract.response: same terminal-result OR durable-operation union in every arm
toolActivationContract.probe: same capability/schema/effect identity; A waits terminal, B/C/D return RUNNING before identical delayed effect completes
toolActivationContract.usageRule: record detachable-call count per unit; all eight D units zero => INCONCLUSIVE
toolActivationContract.failClosed: cannot bind without changing fixed surface => PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION

perRegisteredUnit: provider charged + normalized cost when known

definitions.usefulOperationCount: Count distinct capability/detached-operation executions that reach a terminal successful result bound to the current run and become model-visible or mutate the candidate; duplicate transition/wakeup delivery never increments the count.
definitions.usefulOperationsPerTurn: usefulOperationCount / modelTurns when modelTurns>0; otherwise null with explicit reason.
definitions.usefulOperationOverlapMs: Union duration in which >=2 useful operations are simultaneously RUNNING; zero only when complete operation timing is known.
definitions.recoveryOutcome: NOT_APPLICABLE|RECOVERED|ESCALATED|FAILED|UNKNOWN, derived only from deterministic recovery/fault evidence or an observed live recovery path.
definitions.unknownRule: Unknown token/cost/timing/recovery fields remain null/UNKNOWN and never become zero or success.
